purpose: Pilot comparison of confirmed-match PBP navigation routes using the same Flashscore match and globally regulated read-only source access.
result: Both paths returned complete PBP for sets 1 and 2. The direct-index path removes the summary-page navigation and one durable source-slot operation per match.
interpretation: This is one match with two direct runs and one summary-first run. Flashscore navigation varied substantially between runs, so elapsed-time differences are a pilot only and must not be generalized. The directly verified improvement is one fewer page navigation and one fewer network-slot operation per match. The standalone parser benchmark is separate. A broad paired throughput test across matches, concurrent jobs and browser process starts remains open.
